Implemented immediate product-title rendering in [app/product/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/page.tsx:1).

- `ProductPage` now renders synchronously, placing “Premium Widget” in the prerendered shell.
- Request-time inventory fetching moved into an async child behind `Suspense`.
- Users see “Loading inventory...” until stock and price stream in.
- `npm run build` passes, and `/product` is now reported as partially prerendered.

Existing unrelated `package.json` and `package-lock.json` changes were left untouched.
